title.description: The title text displayed in the card header

description.description: The description text displayed in the card body

tags.description: Array of tag objects with value and color properties

images.description: Array of image objects (currently uses first image)

headerFirst.description: Whether to display the header before the media section

flag.description: Whether to use the flag layout where media and content are side-by-side

mediaRight.description: Whether to place media on the right side in flag layout

mediaInset.description: Whether to inset the media within the card container

mediaExdent.description: Whether to extend the media outside the card container boundaries

children.description: Inner HTML or text content (alternative to structured props)

tag.description: HTML tag to use for the card element (div or li)
